cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Which label colour suits these boxes? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Good labels prevent moving-day confusion.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A commands a move through tiny label decisions, granting B and the driver choice to keep them cooperating instead of confronting A unpacked boxes.
confusable: Unlike normal labeling, the boxes remain empty under a deadline; borrowed authority makes concessions on details to avoid the main work.
comparison: Moving van and driver label preference differ from a lunch host diverting incoming cleaning help toward towel selection.
seedUse: Use D38-b labels/empty boxes/van seed and S02-b revising instructions so participants stay engaged.
